verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API for accessing the platform programmatically, covering account-level resources such as organizations and teams plus data management and export. An MCP server adds triage and project management. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, documented API coverage of UI features such as dashboards, alert rules, and Seer/Autofix, a published OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically. You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects
